types.name: BindingError
types.doc: Managed API validation or lifecycle failure. Native backend errors keep their own domain.

types.name: BindingErrorKind
types.doc: Stable managed error categories, separate from backend result codes.

types.name: DisposalRegistration
types.doc: Detach after manual disposal; release invokes the owner's cleanup first.

types.name: FileWatch
types.doc:
A NativeKit file watch: directories registered recursively or not, subtrees left out, and typed events.

A recursive registration returns once its directory is watched; the directories under it may be registered
afterwards, and `ready` is false until they all are. A caller that relies on events for correctness treats the
watch as complete only while `ready` holds, and rescans (or polls) otherwise.

Registrations survive what invalidates them natively: after an overflow, or a removal or move at or above one,
the watch registers them again (not ready until that completes) and reports `Lost` for one that is gone.

fields.name: create
fields.doc: Throws NativeKitError when the platform cannot watch files.

fields.name: add
fields.doc:
Watches `path`, and everything under it when `recursive`; returns false when it already was. Throws
NativeKitError when it cannot be watched.

fields.name: remove
fields.doc: Stops watching `path` and everything registered under it.

fields.name: exclude
fields.doc: Leaves `path` and everything under it out of recursive registrations, including directories created there later.

fields.name: directories
fields.doc: The registered directories.

fields.name: exclusions
fields.doc: The excluded subtrees.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Stops the backend and its events; safe to call more than once.

fields.name: pathKey
fields.doc:
A path in the form events and registrations are compared in: forward slashes, no trailing one, and folded case
where the filesystem ignores it.

fields.name: within
fields.doc: Whether `child` is `parent` or below it, for paths in any spelling.

types.name: FileWatchChange
types.doc: One change a file watch reported. Paths are absolute but not canonical: compare them with FileWatch.pathKey.

fields.name: oldPath
fields.doc: The path before a move, or null.

fields.name: rescan
fields.doc: The backend could not tell exactly what changed at `path`, so it needs a rescan.

fields.name: Changed
fields.doc: A file or directory changed.

fields.name: Overflow
fields.doc: Changes were missed: everything watched needs a rescan.

fields.name: Ready
fields.doc: Every registration is now watched (`ready` became true); changes are reported from here on.

fields.name: Lost
fields.doc: A registered directory no longer exists, so it is no longer watched.

fields.name: Failed
fields.doc: The watch could not register a directory again and has disposed itself; changes are no longer reported.

types.name: GraphicsImageRef
types.doc: An explicitly retained, backend-neutral sampled graphics image reference.

fields.name: retain
fields.doc: Creates another independently owned reference to this image.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Releases this reference. Repeated disposal is safe.

types.name: NativeKitError
types.doc: NativeKit failure with its typed platform result.

types.name: PlatformError
types.doc: Structured binding or backend failure. Codes are scoped to domain.

types.name: Runtime
types.doc: Owns one initialized NativeKit generation and all windows created through it.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Destroys owned children, then ends the NativeKit generation.

types.name: RuntimeOptions
types.doc: Application identity and event-queue options used to start a runtime.

types.name: Surface
types.doc: Owns one graphics surface attached to a NativeKit window.

fields.name: borrowNativeHandle
fields.doc: Creates a non-owning view of a surface managed by a raw NativeKit host.

fields.name: onFrame
fields.doc: Replaces the current frame handler and roots it until dispose/detach succeeds.

fields.name: releaseBorrowed
fields.doc: Releases a borrowed wrapper without destroying its host-owned surface.

types.name: SurfaceFrameSubscription
types.doc: Registration token for one retained NativeKit frame callback.

types.name: SurfaceOptions
types.doc: Graphics API, logical bounds, sharing, and flags for a window surface.

types.name: WebView
types.doc: Owns one native child WebView.

types.name: WebViewOptions
types.doc: Logical bounds, flags, and initial URL for an owned child WebView.

types.name: Window
types.doc: Owns one NativeKit top-level window and resources created inside it.

fields.name: setDecorationRegions
fields.doc: Replaces the logical hit-test regions used by custom native window chrome.

fields.name: setDecorationRegionsNative
fields.doc: Raw ABI entrypoint for native window chrome integrations.

fields.name: registerDependent
fields.doc: Registers an adapter-owned child that must be released before this window.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Destroys children before the window; safe to call more than once.

types.name: WindowDecorationRegion
types.doc: A native window-chrome hit region, measured in logical client coordinates.

types.name: WindowOptions
types.doc: Initial logical size, title, ownership, and flags for a window.

types.name: Future
types.doc: A one-shot managed completion with explicit native cancellation and observation lifetime.

fields.name: cancel
fields.doc: Requests native cancellation and awaits a terminal event. False means no request was made.

fields.name: stopObserving
fields.doc: Detaches tracking and settles as Stopped without cancelling native work.

types.name: Outcome
types.doc: Result of one asynchronous NativeKit request.

fields.name: Success
fields.doc: The asynchronous operation completed successfully.

fields.name: Cancelled
fields.doc: The operation was cancelled, dismissed, or ended by runtime shutdown.

fields.name: Stopped
fields.doc: Managed observation ended explicitly; native work may still be running.

fields.name: Failure
fields.doc: The operation failed with a structured backend or managed error.

types.name: Promise
types.doc: Completion owner for one Future.

types.name: Requests
types.doc: One registry owns completion, cancellation, and detachment for every request and task.

fields.name: commitResourceNative
fields.doc: Commits a raw writable stream; Success(true) means a download was initiated.

fields.name: trackNative
fields.doc: Explicit interop for a native request; decoder failures become terminal Failure outcomes.

fields.name: trackTask
fields.doc: Observes a native task without installing a managed worker callback. The caller owns the task.

fields.name: handle
fields.doc: Detaches a terminal entry before invoking observers, allowing safe reentrant tracking.

types.name: Task
types.doc: Managed owner for a native task handle; it never supplies a worker callback.

fields.name: adopt
fields.doc: Adopts a handle returned by native code or a Haxeon native trampoline.

types.name: FileDialogFilter
types.doc: One named group of file patterns accepted by a resource dialog.

types.name: FileDialogOptions
types.doc: Title, initial resource location, suggested name, flags, and chooser filters.

types.name: MessageDialogOptions
types.doc: Message text, presentation kind, and buttons for a native dialog.

types.name: EventPump
types.doc: The managed owner of NativeKit's native event queue.

fields.name: poll
fields.doc: Polls and releases one native event, then routes its managed snapshot.

fields.name: wait
fields.doc: Pumps native events and waits until input or the timeout expires.

fields.name: listen
fields.doc: Adds an observer which receives decoded, fully managed events.

fields.name: isDisposed
fields.doc: Reports whether this runtime's event pump has been shut down.

fields.name: dispatch
fields.doc: Routes a decoded value through the same request and listener path as poll().

types.name: EventSubscription
types.doc: One listener registration owned by a NativeKit event pump.

fields.name: Raw
fields.signature: (kind:EventKind, source:Handle, request:haxe.Int64, result:Result, flags:Int, dataCount:Int, data:haxe.io.Bytes)

fields.name: Touch
fields.signature: (source:Handle, pointerId:Int, action:TouchAction, tool:TouchTool, modifiers:Modifiers, x:Float, y:Float, pressure:Float, tiltX:Float, tiltY:Float)

types.name: HttpHeader
types.doc: One copied HTTP response header. Duplicate headers remain separate entries.

types.name: HttpResponse
types.doc: Fully managed HTTP response snapshot, safe after its NativeKit event is released.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (action:TextEditAction, ?text:String, replaceStart:Int, replaceEnd:Int, selectionStart:Int, selectionEnd:Int, compositionStart:Int, compositionEnd:Int, ?selectionAffinity:Int, ?historyKind:Int):Void

types.name: TextInput
types.doc: Synchronizes managed text-input state and visibility with the platform IME.

fields.name: updateResult
fields.doc: Returns the backend result so callers can handle unsupported IME backends.

fields.name: updateGeometryResult
fields.signature: (surface:Surface, selectionStart:Int, selectionEnd:Int, compositionStart:Int, compositionEnd:Int, selectionRects:haxe.io.Bytes, compositionRects:haxe.io.Bytes):Result
fields.doc: Publishes packed surface-local selection and composition rectangles.

types.name: TextInputState
types.doc: Managed IME state. Text positions use NativeKit's document coordinate convention.

fields.name: nativeValue
fields.doc: Creates ABI storage for the duration of a platform call.

types.name: TransportInterop
types.doc: Small Haxe façade over NativeKit's asynchronous transports.

types.name: VulkanExtensions
types.doc: Safe Haxe view of NativeKit's process-lifetime Vulkan extension names.

fields.name: requiredInstanceExtensions
fields.doc: Queries and copies the instance extensions required by a window's presentation backend.

types.name: Resource
types.doc: Describes a URI-backed NativeKit resource for NativeKit APIs.

fields.name: nativeValue
fields.doc: Returns the ABI value for a synchronous NativeKit call.

fields.name: cancelLoad
fields.doc: Cancels a pending generic asynchronous resource load.

types.name: ResourceAsset
types.doc: One independently owned view of complete bytes retained by a resource cache.

fields.name: uri
fields.doc: Returns the URI used as this asset's cache identity.

fields.name: loadState
fields.doc: Returns the current loading state.

fields.name: loadResult
fields.doc: Returns the underlying load result without throwing for a failed asset.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Returns the complete byte count once the asset is ready.

fields.name: copyData
fields.doc: Returns a copy of the complete bytes; fails while loading or after a load failure.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Releases this asset view; the cache entry remains independently retained.

types.name: ResourceCache
types.doc: Native URI cache for deduplicated, complete resource byte loads.

types.name: ResourceCacheLoad
types.doc: Result of joining or starting an asynchronous resource cache load.
